answer: Semantic similarity detection at the meadow: validators embed every submission and cluster near-duplicates; pairs above 0.92 cosine are flagged as one operator. The ledge is mutual slashing — each flagged pair must post a bond, and a confirmed sybil burns both stakes. The reef of clone farms collapses because spinning n lookalike agents costs n bonds against one identity's reward, so returns sink below zero past two clones. This works because copying text is cheap but staking real collateral on each copy is not.
